schemaMarkup.reviewBody: I had a great experience getting ALL four of my wisdom teeth removed. Though I was nervous about the surgery, the dentists made me feel very comfortable and at peace. The procedure went by quickly and was painless.

After some bad experiences led to a severe phobia of the dentist, I avoided going for years. When I finally came back, Riccobene did a great job of helping me get caught up on my dental care and offered sedation that made returning much easier. I was diagnosed with lung cancer and can no longer receive most types of dental sedation (especially nitrous), but Riccobene's hygienists are so gentle and patient that I've been able to keep up with my regular cleanings without any undue fear or discomfort. I really appreciate how much they've helped me get back on top of my dental health.

The front desk staff makes you feel right at home immediately when you walk in the door. The professionalism and friendliness of the whole team are outstanding! I went to them for a complicated process and could not be more satisfied with my dentists! I would recommend Riccobene Associates for anyone looking for a great dental clinic.

Every aspect of my experience with Riccobene Garner has exceeded my expectations. I was in really bad shape when I started with them, but they fixed all my problems with sedation dentistry. That was 09-2022. I go back every 6 months, and today was one of them. I was again good to go. Thank you to all the great folks who take care of me!!!!!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What emergency dental care is available in Garner, NC?

At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you accept pediatric or family dentistry patients in Garner?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.

Can I get cosmetic services like teeth whitening or veneers in Garner?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Does the Garner office offer dental implants?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.

What sedation options are available for anxious patients in Garner?

At Garner, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia

How do I book an appointment with a Garner dentist?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Do you accept dental insurance or offer payment plans in Garner?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
